columns.name: bidding_strategy_id
columns.comment: The ID of the bidding strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_name
columns.comment: The name of the bidding strategy. All bidding strategies within an account must be named distinctly. The length of this string should be between 1 and 255, inclusive, in UTF-8 bytes, (trimmed).

columns.name: bidding_strategy_status
columns.comment: The status of the bidding strategy. This field is read-only.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_cpa_cpc_bid_ceiling_micros
columns.comment: Maximum bid limit that can be set by the bid strategy. The limit applies to all keywords managed by the strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_cpa_cpc_bid_floor_micros
columns.comment: Minimum bid limit that can be set by the bid strategy. The limit applies to all keywords managed by the strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_cpa_target_cpa_micros
columns.comment: Average CPA target. This target should be greater than or equal to minimum billable unit based on the currency for the account.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_roas_cpc_bid_ceiling_micros
columns.comment: Maximum bid limit that can be set by the bid strategy. The limit applies to all keywords managed by the strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_roas_cpc_bid_floor_micros
columns.comment: Minimum bid limit that can be set by the bid strategy. The limit applies to all keywords managed by the strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_roas_target_roas
columns.comment: Required. The desired revenue (based on conversion data) per unit of spend. Value must be between 0.01 and 1000.0, inclusive.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_spend_cpc_bid_ceiling_micros
columns.comment: Maximum bid limit that can be set by the bid strategy. The limit applies to all keywords managed by the strategy.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_target_spend_target_spend_micros
columns.comment: The spend target under which to maximize clicks. A TargetSpend bidder will attempt to spend the smaller of this value or the natural throttling spend amount. If not specified, the budget is used as the spend target.

columns.name: bidding_strategy_type
columns.comment: The type of the bidding strategy. Create a bidding strategy by setting the bidding scheme. This field is read-only.

columns.name: customer_descriptive_name
columns.comment: Optional, non-unique descriptive name of the customer.
